Explyt AI Agent

Install with the Explyt installer, then run explyt:
  explyt install [--channel stable|dogfood]      install or update the managed installation
Or run a pinned version without installing:
  npx -y @explyt/ai-agent@<version>             start the terminal UI
  npx -y @explyt/ai-agent@<version> tui         start the terminal UI
  npx -y @explyt/ai-agent@<version> login       store a provider credential
  npx -y @explyt/ai-agent@<version> logout      remove stored credentials

Commands: explyt tui | login | logout | plugin | install | update | config
  explyt update      update the managed installation now (same as install)
  explyt config set updateChannel stable|dogfood | autoUpdate true|false | cacheWarming off|streaming|idle
  explyt plugin      manage Marketplace plugins (explyt plugin help)
  --permission-mode default|paranoid|bypassPermissions   start the terminal UI in that mode
  -h, --help         show this message
  -v, --version      print the version

Credentials and sessions are separate from other agents: logging in to a pi you run
by hand does not log in here, so run login once for this agent.
The terminal UI notes a newer version at startup.
EXPLYT_OFFLINE=1 turns off the update check and the model catalogue refresh (PI_OFFLINE
no longer stops the update check). Model, web, MCP and Telegram requests and usage telemetry
still go out.
IDE (ACP) integration is set up by the Explyt installer, which places the adapter
next to this package; it is not part of this package.
